wios.description: Fully wireless Si-CMOS direct conversion intraoral X-ray sensor with Bluetooth 5.0, Zero Profile® holders, and FDA 510(k) clearance.

ufs.description: Single-photon-sensitive CdTe-CMOS linear scanning sensor for dental panoramic, cephalometric, medical, and industrial imaging.

ufsIp67.description: IP67-rated ultra-fast TDI scanning detector for continuous inline industrial inspection, with no active cooling required.

manufacturing.description: CMOS wafer bumping, flip-chip bonding, wire bonding, die assembly, and detector characterization at Athlos and VTT Micronova.

software.description: TWAIN module, reconstruction algorithm libraries, post-processing filters, and SDK for integration with TWAIN-enabled imaging platforms.
